title: Niagara Falls Tour Boat Ride and Skylon Tower
includes: Spanish, French, Portuguese, Japanese, English Guides
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the awe of Niagara Falls on an intimate small-group tour that showcases its majestic views and power. Begin at Skylon Tower, soaring 520 feet above for breathtaking panoramic vistas of the iconic Bridal Veil, Horseshoe, and American Falls. Next, journey 125 feet below the surface at Journey Behind the Falls, where the sheer force of the cascading water is palpable. This guided experience, limited to 15 guests, ensures personalized attention and insider knowledge from a local expert, providing a truly immersive adventure without the crowds. The Niagara Falls boat ride is an epic thrill‑ride that takes you right into the misty heart of the Falls. You hop on a sturdy vessel that cruises close to the thundering waterfalls, soaking you in spray and giving you a jaw‑dropping view of the 188‑foot drop. The experience is both heart‑pounding and breathtaking, leaving you with unforgettable mist‑kissed memories.
